zh: 这次主要处理长文档打开时的等待：先编辑当前公式，其余列表分批加载，加载中的输入和字号修改会保留。补充旧 MathType 字符、颜色和多行结构的显示，修复误报未保存修改。更新编号现在支持旧 MathType 序号和相关交叉引用。已用长文档副本测试保存、样式、删除后重编号和重开；私人测试材料不会随包发布。少数未识别的旧字体字符仍会显示方框和提示，原始数据保留。
en: This update focuses on long-document loading: open the selected equation first, then load the list in batches while retaining typing and point-size changes. More legacy MathType characters, colors, and multiline structures display correctly, and false unsaved-change warnings are fixed. Update Numbers now handles legacy MathType sequences and related references. Saving, styles, renumbering after deletion, and reopening were tested on a private long-document copy, which is not distributed. Some unmapped legacy font characters still show a square and a warning, with original data retained.
